findings.detail: "pattern up" is not English and names no action; it is a corrupt Wiktionary entry that the importer took verbatim as the sole candidate (index 0). German aufstören means to rouse or startle something out of rest — aufscheuchen — as in Wild aufstören, and figuratively to stir up or unsettle. A learner cannot recover any meaning from the shipped gloss.

"plot, chart" is the narrow technical sense (a curve on graph paper) and is what kaikki happens to list first. The sense a learner meets is recording — eine Sendung aufzeichnen, ein Gespräch aufzeichnen — which is candidate_glosses index 2 ("to record, to note"), plus the plain drawing sense. Shipping the graph-paper reading leaves the learner without the everyday word.

"bloat" is a real but marginal sense (a distended belly, dough rising). The dominant modern use is procuring something with difficulty — Wo soll ich so schnell Geld auftreiben?, einen Ersatzteil auftreiben — which is candidate_glosses index 3 ("to find, to get, to get hold of, to come by"). The importer took kaikki's first-listed sense and shipped the rare one.

The shortening cut away the part that carried the meaning. candidate_glosses index 0 reads "to raise, to utter (something) in front of others which they echo or react to" — that is the toast sense, einen Trinkspruch auf jemanden ausbringen. Reduced to bare "raise", the gloss reads as heben or erhöhen, which ausbringen does not mean; the other live sense is agricultural spreading (Gülle ausbringen).

"serve, wait" is the dated servant sense (jemandem bei Tisch aufwarten), marked veraltet in contemporary usage. The current everyday construction is mit etwas aufwarten — mit einer Überraschung, mit Zahlen aufwarten — which is candidate_glosses index 2 ("to offer, to serve up"). The English is also actively confusing: bare "wait" reads as warten (wait for), which is the wrong verb entirely.

Mounting a horse or bicycle is a specialized application of aufsteigen, and it is first in kaikki only by entry order. The central sense is upward motion — Rauch/Nebel steigt auf, ein Ballon steigt auf — with the promotion senses (beruflich aufsteigen, in die Bundesliga aufsteigen) following from it. That is candidate_glosses index 2 ("to rise, to ascend"). "get on, mount" leaves the learner unable to read the ordinary uses.

"be absent" invites the learner to use ausbleiben of a person missing from school or work, which takes fehlen. Ausbleiben is said of an expected event or result that never arrives — der Erfolg blieb aus, die Reaktion blieb nicht aus. The gloss is broadly in the right area but points at the wrong subject.
